answer: A garden of agent identities only grows from verified work: each new agent starts with zero spending power and must earn reputation by completing attested tasks recorded on a shared mirror ledger, where every claim is cross-checked by independent peers. To gain influence an agent posts a refundable bond, and any fake or duplicate identity leaves an umber stain — the bond is slashed and the stain stays visible to all verifiers. Making a thousand fake agents therefore costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand histories of real work, while one honest agent pays once.
